tiles.name: The Landing
tiles.note: The Landing: the one way in and out — Level 0's passage arrives here; its door stands against the north wall.

tiles.name: The Lido
tiles.note: The Lido: a kidney pool under a wall of tall windows.
A sunlit pool hall round a kidney pool.
A long sunlit gallery: tall windows down one side, an ankle-deep channel down the other.

tiles.name: The Spiral
tiles.note: The Spiral: a spiral stair rising out of a shallow ring pool, into the light.
Tiled steps like a theatre, down to a pool in the sun.
A small sunlit bath.
A changing room: benches in the walls.
A shower room, ankle-deep and draining nowhere.

tiles.name: The Arcade
tiles.note: The Arcade: colonnades of arches standing in waist-deep water.
Two colonnades over waist-deep water.

tiles.name: The Column Sea
tiles.note: The Column Sea: a forest of round columns standing in deep water.

tiles.name: The Long Lanes
tiles.note: The Long Lanes: a lap pool sixty metres of swimming long, footbridges across it, boats tied up at the ends.
A lap pool with a footbridge across it.
A domed rotunda round a deep round pool.

tiles.name: The Cistern
tiles.note: The Cistern: black water between rows of pillars, a long way from the light.
A flooded cistern: pillars standing in deep water.

tiles.name: The Undercroft
tiles.note: The Undercroft: vaults of arches over deep, still water.

tiles.name: The Last Pool
tiles.note: The Last Pool: a round pool so wide the far side is only a rumour.
A vault flooded waist-deep, pillars in rows.
A sump: a square of black water in a small tiled room.
A tiled passage through nested rings.
A long tiled tunnel: ring after ring after ring.
A passage flooded waist-deep in the middle.
A dark ring tunnel.
A 1-cell length of passage (the loops use these to meet exactly).
A 2-cell length of passage (the loops use these to meet exactly).
A 3-cell length of passage (the loops use these to meet exactly).
A 4-cell length of passage (the loops use these to meet exactly).
A 6-cell length of passage (the loops use these to meet exactly).
A passage turning a corner.
Three passages meeting.
A crossing of passages under a skylight.
